concepts.name: Gradient descent
concepts.definition: An iterative algorithm that updates parameters along the negative gradient of the loss.

evidence.quote: updates parameters in the direction of the negative gradient of the loss

concepts.name: Activation functions
concepts.definition: Functions such as ReLU that add non-linearity to a network.

evidence.quote: introduce non-linearity so that a network can represent more than a linear map

concepts.name: Chain rule
concepts.definition: The derivative of a composite function is the product of the derivatives of its parts.

evidence.quote: compute the derivative of a composite function by multiplying the derivatives of its parts

concepts.name: Backpropagation
concepts.definition: Applies the chain rule layer by layer to get the gradient of the loss for every weight.

evidence.quote: applies the chain rule layer by layer from the output back to the input

concepts.name: Overfitting
concepts.definition: A model memorizes the training data.

evidence.quote: overfitting is always caused by having too many parameters
